description_en: Deletes an agent account from the AICCS Customer Service Workbench based on the agent account name. This operation performs a logical deletion. If you re-add the agent after the deletion, the agent ID remains unchanged
description_zh: 根据坐席账号名称，删除悉犀客服工作台坐席账号，逻辑删除，删除后重新添加，坐席ID不变
name: DeleteAgent

parameters.help_en: The unique client request ID used for idempotency verification. You can use UUID to generate the ID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AICCS instance. You can view the instance ID in the Intelligent Contact Center console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent account. The name must be unique within the instance. It is used as the logon name
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，实例内唯一（登录名）
parameters.name: account_name

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于跟踪错误原因

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
